title: fix(types,fields,plugin-form)!: the grid widget reads each field-level key under the one spelling GridFieldMetadata declares (objectui#11070 round 8)
body:
Refs #11070
Clause-②: yes (narrowing). `GridFieldMetadata.allow_reorder` either retires or becomes the read key, and the undeclared reads are declared or retired. It is priced in the changeset.

As landed: `allow_reorder` became the read key. The published `GridFieldMetadata` face widens by two optional members (`total_field`, `add_label`), and what the grid widget honours narrows by five retired reads (`reorderable`, `amount_field`, `amountField`, `allow_duplicate`, `show_line_numbers`). Priced minor with the break stated in `.changeset/11070-grid-field-keys-round8.md` (the fixed group never declares `major`).

Round 8 of objectui#11070: the grid widget's field-level keys, the round the round-7 seat review (`5926481945`) answered A. Claim `5927734710`, session `session_01TdiauJaVCHuj45EzZGUxHh`. Measured first; each key now has one spelling, and that spelling is declared and read.

## Per-key table (base `5638529e` → head)

Readers and producers are cited by symbol, not by line address (AGENTS.md #11).

| Key | Declared (before → after) | Produced (measured at base) | Read by `GridField` (before → after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `allow_reorder` | `GridFieldMetadata` → same | no producer; taught by `grid.mdx`'s typed fence | not read → **read** |
| `reorderable` | none | none in either repository | read → **retired** |
| `total_field` | none → **`GridFieldMetadata`** | `MasterDetailForm` `field={…}` (from the detail's `amountField`), `LineItemsPanel` `gridField` (from `amountField`), console `DevLookup` dev page | read (the one spelling) |
| `amount_field` | none | none | read → **retired** |
| `amountField` (on the widget) | none | nothing writes it into the widget's config | read → **retired** |
| `add_label` | none → **`GridFieldMetadata`** | `MasterDetailForm` (from `subforms[].addLabel` / `details[].addLabel`; `detail.add` in form mode) | read |
| `allow_duplicate` | none | none | read → **retired** (duplicate follows `allow_add`) |
| `show_line_numbers` | none | none | read → **retired** (the column always shows) |
| `sort_field` | none → none (**held**, see below) | `MasterDetailForm` from `d.sortField`, which is the authored `details[].sortField` or else `deriveDetail`'s derived sort field | read (now named in `UndeclaredGridKeys`) |
| `min_rows` / `max_rows` | `GridFieldMetadata` | both adapters (from `minRows` / `maxRows`) | read (unchanged) |
| `allow_add` / `allow_delete` | `GridFieldMetadata` | `LineItemsPanel` (from `readonly`) | read (unchanged) |

`GridField` now reads its config as a `Partial` of `GridFieldMetadata` plus the one named undeclared key, so a read of an undeclared key fails to compile (ablation A5 below).

## Where the keys come from (measured)

- **No `grid` field type in the spec.** Installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 `FieldType` has no `grid`, and neither has objectstack `origin/main` `7a606a9a`. Every `type: 'grid'` hit in objectstack (examples, platform objects, `cli` generators, `metadata-protocol`) is a LIST VIEW, not a field.
- **Spec carriers that feed the widget:** `FieldSchema.inlineEdit: 'grid'` with `inlineTitle` / `inlineColumns` / `inlineAmountField`, which `attachInlineSubforms` (app-shell `MetadataProvider`) turns into derived `subforms[]` entries (`childObject`, `relationshipField`, `inlineMode`, `title`, `columns`, `amountField`; no `sortField`); the strict form `subforms[]` entry (`childObject`, `relationshipField`, `columns`, `amountField`, `totalField`, `title`, `addLabel`, `minRows`, `maxRows`, plus its folded aliases; no `sortField`); `object-master-detail-form` `details`, which the spec types `z.array(z.unknown())`; and `record:line_items`, which has no spec row (objectstack's showcase page writes `amountField` there, no `totalField`).
- **The adapters** that build the widget's config: `MasterDetailForm` writes `columns`, `total_field`, `sort_field`, `min_rows`, `max_rows`, `add_label` (the six-key set `masterDetailDetailsMembers-8071` pins, unchanged); `LineItemsPanel` writes `columns`, `total_field`, `min_rows`, `max_rows`, `allow_add`, `allow_delete`.
- **Authored paths to `type: 'grid'`:** objectui's `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/fields-grid/*` (three `form` documents whose `fields[]` entry is `type: 'grid'`; they write `name`, `label`, `type`, `columns` and `readonly`, no field-level key) and `content/docs/fields/grid.mdx`. objectstack: none. A census of all twelve snake_case keys across objectstack `origin/main` reads 0 files each (control: `amountField` hits 10).

## The two adapters' total, aligned

`MasterDetailForm` showed the grid total whenever `amountField` was set; `LineItemsPanel` only when `totalField` was ALSO set. The alignment is the one `total_field:` line in `LineItemsPanel`'s `gridField`, now mapped exactly as `MasterDetailForm` maps it (`amountField`, else `'amount'` when only `totalField` is set). The widget key is the CHILD column summed (the spec's `amountField`), never the spec's `totalField`.

## Held at the key: `sort_field` (needs a seat answer)

It has a live producer, so per the brief it stops at the key: no declaration, no retirement. `deriveDetail` derives the sort field from the child object's fields (`position` / `sort_order` / `sequence` / `line_no` / `line_number` / `sort`) when none is authored, and `MasterDetailForm` writes it as `sort_field`; objectui#11144 made that derivation reach details with authored columns. The strict `subforms[]` carrier does not declare `sortField`, and the spec has no inline sort-field key. Whether it becomes a declared key is in the report's `open_questions`.

## Reorder probe (`GridField`, two rows)

| | no key | `allow_reorder: false` | `reorderable: false` |
|---|---|---|---|
| base `5638529e` | 2 handles | **2** handles | 0 handles |
| head | 2 handles | **0** handles | 2 handles |

The base row is the same new pin file run against base `GridField`: 6 red, 5 green.

## M3 (`scripts/measure-strict-authoring-face.mjs --json`)

Base `5638529e` → head `f877cc6b` (pre-merge; the merge brought no corpus change to these keys): `totals` and every per-component row are identical (2229 nodes, 77 strict-refused, 46 strict-only, 31 red today; 601 documents, 72 strict-refused whole tree). Hypothesis H4 holds: the widget's config is built in code, and no corpus document writes a field-level key. Only two diagnostic fields moved: `rendererMentionsOfUndeclaredKeys` (a raw word count over renderer sources, moved by this diff's new comments and tests) and `unloadableModules` (an environmental reading: app-shell was unbuilt at the base run).

## Ablations (predictions written before each run)

Each mutation went through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob changed, restored to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty).

- **A1 reorder:** read `reorderable` again. Predicted 2 red; got 2 red, 9 green.
- **A2 total:** read `total_field || amount_field || amountField` again. Predicted the two retired-spelling rows red; got 2 red, 9 green.
- **A2b line-items total:** restore the base mapping in `LineItemsPanel`. Predicted "`amountField` alone shows the footer total" red; got 1 red, 1 green.
- **A3 `allow_duplicate`:** read it again. Predicted 1 red; got 1 red, 10 green.
- **A4 `show_line_numbers`:** gate the `#` header on it again. Predicted 1 red; got 1 red, 10 green.
- **A5 declared face:** `GridFieldMetadata` loses `total_field` and `add_label` and gains the retired `reorderable`; `@object-ui/types` rebuilt, and the dist markers checked (planted 0 → 1, declared 1 → 0 each). Predicted and got: fields `tsc --noEmit` TS2339 on the `total_field` read and both `add_label` reads; fields `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` TS2353 on the `declared` fixture and the two `grid({…})` calls, plus TS2578 (unused `@ts-expect-error`) on `retiredReorderable`; `check:doc-snippets` 1 failed block, `grid.mdx` TS2353 `total_field`. Restore leg: source restored, `@object-ui/types` rebuilt, markers back (0 / 1 / 1), `git status --porcelain` empty.

## Carried check (round-6 note): `formula.mdx`'s `addDays` / `daysBetween`

Both evaluate. A probe through the installed `@objectstack/formula` 17.5.0 `ExpressionEngine.evaluate` (CEL, pinned `now`): `addDays(record.created_at, 7)` with `2026-09-28` gives `2026-10-05`; `daysBetween(record.start_date, record.end_date)` gives 29, and −29 with the arguments swapped. Control: an unregistered `addWeeks(…)` fails with `found no matching overload`. Both are registered in objectstack's `packages/formula` stdlib (`registerStdLib`). `formula.mdx` is unchanged.

## Local verification

At head `1f2f81cf` (the merge of `origin/main` `ad58cc15`):

- `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/layout` and `@object-ui/fields` builds; `type-check` green for `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/example-schema-catalog`. Both new test files are in their packages' `tsconfig.test.json` programs (`--listFiles`).
- Tests: `packages/types/` plus every `GridField*` and `LineItemsPanel*` test and `masterDetailDetailsMembers-8071`: 338 files, 8164 tests passed. Before the merge, at `f877cc6b`, the four whole packages (`packages/types/`, `packages/fields/`, `packages/plugin-form/`, `examples/schema-catalog/`) ran 733 files passed and 1 skipped, 15543 tests passed and 8 skipped. The merge touched none of `fields`, `plugin-form` or `schema-catalog`, nor any of their dependencies' sources; it touched three `types` tests, which the post-merge run covers.
- `check:doc-snippets` (closure built through the lock): 768 of 768 blocks, 0 failed. `check:doc-fences`, `docs:check-links`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:i18n-keys`, the line-citation gate (0 new) and `check-type-check-coverage` are green.
- Changeset gates: `check-changeset-presence`, `changeset:check`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check:changeset-claims` and `check:pending-changeset-literals` are green. The claims gate names two pending changesets that cite a touched file (`6357-basechema-bind-declaration`, which names `grid.mdx`; `6625-retire-fieldmeta-decimals`, which names `GridField.tsx`). Both paragraphs were read and still hold, so no dated note is owed.
- Narrowed lint over the five changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 errors. The population is the eslint config's own `**/*.{ts,tsx}` blocks, and `.mdx`/`.md` match none of them. The file count, 5, is read from `--format json`. The config is not type-aware (`tseslint.configs.recommended`, no `parserOptions.project`, no custom rule reading the filesystem), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. Warnings went 49 → 48 on the three modified files (the `cfg` `any` is gone), plus 1 on the new line-items test (its `as any` adapter mock, the sibling tests' convention).
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the changed paths: NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

- **The form-field face carries none of the field-level family.** `FormField` / `FormFieldSchema` declare none of `min_rows`, `max_rows`, `allow_add`, `allow_delete`, `allow_reorder`, nor now `total_field` / `add_label`. So a `form` `fields[]` grid entry that writes one reaches the widget at runtime, and the strict face refuses it by name. This predates the round for the first five keys; no corpus document writes any of them (M3 does not count them). Mirroring is `form.ts` / `form.zod.ts` territory (open PR #11360), excluded by the claim, and is raised in the report's `open_questions`, not done here.
- **`docs/adr/0001-master-detail-subform.md`** (governed, Tier H) still names `allow_reorder` as future work and `sort_field`. An ADR records the decision taken; left as is, the seat's standing disposition for ADRs.
- **`grid.mdx`'s "Features" list** claims a "Pagination Preview … Showing X of Y" that `GridField` does not render. That prose is outside this round's key set; noted, not changed.
- **`fields-grid` fixtures are unchanged:** they write no field-level key, so they already carry only declared and read keys.
- **`sort_field`** is described above and left as is.
